title: PHP 8.2.27 Released!
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.2.27. This is a bug fix release.

All PHP 8.2 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 8.2.27 please visit our , Windows source and binaries can be found on . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagewindows.php.net/download/ChangeLog

Please note, this is the last bug-fix release for the 8.2.x series. Security fix support will continue until 31 Dec 2026. For more information, please check our page. Supported Versions
author: PHP.net news & announcements
